# v3 phase 1: pre-war events (generated by tools/build_systems.py). Namespace nsr is declared in NSR_events.txt
add_namespace = nsr

country_event = {
	id = nsr.200
	title = nsr.200.t
	desc = nsr.200.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_nsr_exiles_of_sabilla
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.200.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.202
	title = nsr.202.t
	desc = nsr.202.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_read_write
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.202.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 2 }
		add_political_power = -25
		set_country_flag = NSR_maliki_fatwa_done
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_debate_follows
		hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = nsr.203 days = 10 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.202.b
		trigger = { check_variable = { NSR_inst_qadis > 0 } }
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value = 0.03 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_ikhwan_side }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_fitna_p5
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = 5 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
		set_country_flag = NSR_maliki_fatwa_done
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.202.c
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_hold_all_m5
		hidden_effect = {
			every_owned_state = {
				set_temp_variable = { NSR_hold_delta = -5 }
				NSR_state_hold_change = yes
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = NSR_maliki_fatwa_done
	}
}

			}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.211
	title = nsr.211.t
	desc = nsr.211.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_sign_treaty1
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.211.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 3 }
		set_country_flag = NSR_decree_active
		if = {
			limit = { capital_scope = { check_variable = { NSR_hold > 49 } } }
			activate_mission = NSR_registration_decree_mission_2
		}
		else = {
			activate_mission = NSR_registration_decree_mission
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.211.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_inst_hijras_m1
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_inst_hijras = -1 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
		add_power_balance_value = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop value = -0.05 tooltip_side = NSR_bop_court_side }
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_fitna_m5
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = -5 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.213
	title = nsr.213.t
	desc = nsr.213.d
	picture = GFX_report_event_generic_conference
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = nsr.213.a
		ai_chance = { factor = 3 }
		set_country_flag = NSR_inquiry_active
		activate_mission = NSR_consul_inquiry_mission
	}
	option = {
		name = nsr.213.b
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
		set_country_flag = NSR_inquiry_done
		custom_effect_tooltip = NSR_tt_fitna_p3
		hidden_effect = {
			add_to_variable = { NSR_fitna = 3 }
			NSR_clamp_turmoil = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = ENG }
			ENG = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = ROOT modifier = NSR_consul_report } }
		}
		set_country_flag = NSR_british_hostile
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = nsr.290
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_power_balance = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop } }
			remove_power_balance_modifier = { id = NSR_dual_power_bop modifier = NSR_bop_court_stipends }
		}
	}
